main_text.p: liquum fieri, Superesse, Remanere: Præt. לֹא נוֹתַר [?] Non reliqua fuit ulla anima, Josh.II.11. Futur. כָּל נִשְׁמָה [?] Et relictus sum ego solus, 1.Reg.19.10. וְאוֹתַר [?]
יוֹתֵר [?] m. Excellentia, Emolumentum, Eccles.7. v.12. Residuum, 1.Sam.15.15. Et adverbialiter, Nimium, Amplius, Magis, Potius, Eccles.12.12.

יָתִיר [?] m. Chald. Excellens: וְיִיתֵר יָתִיר [?] Et splendor ejus excellens erat, Dan.2.31. Fœmin. וְרַבּוּ יְתִירָא [?] Et amplitudo excellentior, Daniel.4.33. Et adverbialiter, יְתִירָא [?] Excellenter, id est, Valde, Vehementer, Abundanter, Dan.3.22.

יָתֵר [?] m. Residuum, Reliquum, Jud.7.6. Excellentia, Genes.49.3. Item, Chorda, Restis, Nervus: Psalm.11.2. Aff. יִתְרוֹ [?] Chordam meam, Job.30.11. scribitur cum ו in fine, sed legitur per י: Plur. יְתָרִים לְחַיִּים [?] Restibus virentibus, Jud.16.7. Est & Adjectivum, juxta Ab.Esr. יָתֵר מְאֹד [?] Excellens valdè, Jes.56.12.
יָתוֹר [?] m. Excellens: Constr. יְתוֹר הָרִים [?] Excellentissimum montium, Jobi 39.11. Vide etiam תּוֹר [?].
יִתְרָה [?] f. Residuum, Jes.15.7. Et in ת, יִתְרַת [?] Jer.4.8. cui simile fuit supra in יֵשׁ [?] in Nomine שָׁנָה [?], & in זַמַּר [?] in Nomine זִמְרָה [?].

יִתְרוֹן [?] m. Emolumentum, Præstantia, in Ecclesiaste sapius: כְּיִתְרוֹן הָאוֹר [?] Ut est emolumentum lucis, Eccl.2.13. pro כְּיִתְרוֹן [?] cui simile vide supra in יִלְלָה [?] in Nomine יִלְלָה [?].
מוֹתָר [?] m. Præstantia, Emolumentum, Prov. 14. v. 23. Constr. וּמוֹתַר הָאָדָם [?] Et præstantia hominis, Eccles.3.19.
מִיתָרִים [?] m. p. Funes, Nervi: Aff. וְכָל־מִיתָרִי [?] Et omnes funes mei, Jer.10.20. בְּמִיתָרֶיךָ [?] Nervis tuis, Psal.21.13.

page.notes: The Hebrew forms are copied from a small scan at reduced resolution; the vowel points and several Hebrew headwords are uncertain and marked [?]. The top mark ת is treated as a running head, and the foot mark is read as a catchword; it could also be a gathering signature. The first line is a fragment from the previous page and is kept as it stands. Printed Scripture references are copied as printed, including "Jobi 39.11" and "Jes.15.7" with no correction.
